reference.title: Scenario 1 — Internal cross-references and bookmarks
reference.shortdesc: Consider a document where the author has used Insert -> Cross-reference or Insert -> Hyperlink

section.p: Consider a document where the author has used Insert -> Cross-reference or Insert -> Hyperlink to create internal links — for example, "See the Configuration section on page 14" or a hyperlink that jumps to a bookmark elsewhere in the same document.

row.entry: [Normal]: For prerequisites, see Prerequisites section. [Normal]: Refer to the Configuration Guide.

entry.codeblock:
For prerequisites, see the Prerequisites section .

Refer to the Configuration Guide .

section.p: Result:Ifvalid internal links and/bookmarks are present, then the converter maps to the correct converted DITA topic. If unresolved, then the converter reports the broken xrefs.
